name: uv_mutex_lock

ownership.argument: astrolink takes the default loop's mutex through this. On p67 the mutex is a NuttX pthread_mutex_t (uv_mutex_init calls the pthread functions directly), so the lock wrapper is the pthread lock and not a libuv-internal primitive.

provenance.source: Twelve-byte wrapper that tail-calls the real lock body 0xC204E3C with a null timeout argument; 260 call sites. The body 0xC204E3C lives in nuttx/sched/pthread/pthread_mutextimedlock.c (its own assertion string) and operates on a plain NuttX pthread_mutex_t: it takes the semaphore at mutex+8 and dispatches through 0xC205310 when the fast path fails. uv_mutex_init 0xC2DCF1C initialises exactly that structure with pthread_mutexattr_init / attr_settype(1) / pthread_mutex_init / attr_destroy, which is what identifies the wrapper as the lock.

notes: astrolink takes the default loop's mutex through this. On p67 the mutex is a NuttX pthread_mutex_t (uv_mutex_init calls the pthread functions directly), so the lock wrapper is the pthread lock and not a libuv-internal primitive.
